commands.name: search-features
commands.summary: Search caniuse features by keyword; returns matching feature IDs (caniuse, wf-* web-features and mdn-* BCD IDs)

commands.name: get-feature-support
commands.summary: Get full support data (title, description, spec, baseline status, per-browser per-version support stats) for one or more feature IDs

commands.name: compare-browsers
commands.summary: Compare feature support between browser versions; returns the raw comparison result (IDs of features whose support differs between the given versions)

commands.name: get-feature-page
commands.summary: Get a feature's detail page summary: title, spec link and status, description and global usage percentages (works for caniuse IDs, wf-* and mdn-* IDs)

commands.name: list-features-index
commands.summary: List all features in the caniuse index (titles and links, grouped by category in page order: CSS, HTML5, ...); the feature ID is the last path segment of href (e.g. 'css-rrggbbaa')

commands.name: list-news
commands.summary: List latest caniuse news / newly added features

commands.name: get-usage-table
commands.summary: Get the browser usage-share table: per browser, the versions with their global usage percentage

commands.name: list-feature-suggestions
commands.summary: List the top suggested features not yet on caniuse, ranked by GitHub votes
